checked.claim: Pending VBK case where a nationally operating company used corporate or accounting arrangements to lower turnover base
checked.evidence: Tätigkeitsbericht 2025: 'Die DSS weist allerdings darauf hin, dass auch rein national tätige Unternehmen in Einzelfällen versuchen, ihre massgeblichen Umsatzzahlen durch unterschiedliche gesellschaftsrechtliche oder buchhalterische Gestaltungen zu reduzieren ... Ein entsprechender Fall ist derzeit bei der zuständigen Beschwerdekommission für Verwaltungsangelegenheiten (VBK) hängig.' The report speaks of attempts, not of a company having succeeded; the case is described only as 'corresponding'.
checked.replacement: The DSS reports that purely national companies have in some cases tried to reduce the turnover used to calculate a fine through corporate or accounting arrangements, and that a corresponding case is pending before the VBK; the DSS relies on CJEU case law that the whole undertaking's turnover counts. Company and amount not published.

checked.claim: DSS punishes as Übertretung; CHF 11m/2%, CHF 22m/4% (Art. 40)
checked.evidence: Art. 40(1)-(2): 'Von der Datenschutzstelle wird wegen Übertretung mit Busse ... bestraft'; bis zu 11 Millionen Franken oder 2 %; bis zu 22 Millionen Franken oder 4 %. Negligence suffices ('wenn auch nur fahrlässig').
Art. 40(7): 'Gegen Behörden und sonstige öffentliche Stellen werden keine Bussen verhängt.'

checked.claim: Arts. 41-42 up to six months or 360 daily units (up to one year for financial gain), before Landgericht
checked.evidence: Version 1 text: Arts. 41 and 42 'bis zu sechs Monaten oder Geldstrafe bis zu 360 Tagessätzen'. No aggravated one-year tier found in Art. 41; Landgericht jurisdiction not confirmed in the fetched text.
checked.replacement: Caps are expressed in Swiss francs. Separate criminal offences for unauthorised obtaining of data (Art. 41) and breach of data secrecy (Art. 42), punishable by up to six months' imprisonment or up to 360 daily units, are handled by the criminal courts, not the DSS.

checked.evidence: Art. 20(1): 'binnen vier Wochen ab Zustellung Beschwerde bei der Beschwerdekommission für Verwaltungsangelegenheiten'.
Art. 20(1) and (2): 'binnen vier Wochen ab Zustellung' for both VBK and VGH; the DSS also has a right of appeal to the VGH.

Art. 20(3): 'Die Datenschutzstelle darf Entscheidungen und Verfügungen gegenüber einer öffentlichen Stelle die aufschiebende Wirkung nicht entziehen.' This presupposes that appeals have suspensive effect which the DSS can otherwise withdraw.
checked.replacement: Appeals appear to have suspensive effect under the general administrative procedure law, which the DSS may withdraw, except for decisions against public bodies, where it may not (Art. 20(3) DSG).

checked.claim: VGH, described by DSS as final instance
checked.evidence: DSS Beschwerderecht page: the Verwaltungsgerichtshof decides 'letztinstanzlich'. Art. 20(2) DSG.

checked.claim: No complaint deadline; informed within a reasonable time
checked.evidence: DSS page: complainant informed 'innerhalb eines angemessenen Zeitraums über den Stand des Verfahrens'; no deadline stated.

checked.claim: Head elected for six years; Gächter second term from 1 January 2026
checked.evidence: Art. 12: 'für eine Dauer von sechs Jahren'. Tätigkeitsbericht 2025: 'meiner zweiten Amtszeit, die am 1. Januar 2026 begonnen hat'.
No limitation provision in Art. 40 DSG; general rules on Übertretungen not checked.

notes: No serious errors. The file only has one case and no named fine; the 2025 activity report states fines have so far been imposed only on companies ('bislang Geldbussen nur gegen Unternehmen'), which could be added to quirks. Art. 40(3)-(5) make legal persons liable for offences by managers and for organisational failures, and Art. 40(6) commits the DSS to warnings for first-time breaches: both worth a quirk. All DSG checks were against version 1 (2018); the current consolidated version (dated 1 April 2026 on gesetze.li) could not be read, so amendments are unchecked.
